description: Get one mail domain by id, with the fields list_mail_domains describes. A domain in another workspace, or one that was removed, answers 404. Each row in `records` has `step`, `type`, the full `name`, `nameInZone` relative to `dnsHost.zone` (`@` at the zone itself, null when unknown), `value`, `priority`, `check` and `observed`. If `check` is `unanswered` or `not_checked`, call check_mail_domain again before changing DNS. Publish only rows with `check: not_verified` or `wrong` and a non-null `value`, using your own DNS access, then check again. Keep one DMARC record per name and never weaken an existing policy. At Cloudflare, CNAMEs stay DNS only, not proxied. Add the MX last, because it moves incoming mail. We never take a DNS password or token.
name: get_mail_domain
title: Get a mail domain
